RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: cannot be responsibly estimated from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your qualifications justify asking how candidates were assessed, but the announcement may omit relevant experience, and interviews may have distinguished candidates.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, comparative assessment, and applicable rules on panel composition. Raise the panel’s composition as a procedural question if those rules require gender balance—not as proof of bias.

Preserve correspondence and check local complaint deadlines; don’t assume waiting for reasons pauses them. Two weeks’ silence alone does not establish wrongdoing. Which country was this in, and is the school public or private?
